box.english: Could you review the report, please?

last_email.angle: Two questions first: ask two follow-up questions before you share your own view, once today.

today.body:
After you finish lunch, call Mom and say, “Hi Mom, how was your week?”
If the day feels rough, just say, “Hi Mom,” and hang up – under 30 seconds.
Reason: a specific cue (finishing lunch) and a brief script make the call automatic; evidence: mixed.
Español del día: "¿Cómo estuvo tu día?" – a simple, polite question you can use after the call.

Note from M: Let me know if the cue works for you.

Source: Skin care products tainted with mercury, warns FDA - FOX 8 News - https://news.google.?oc=5

b.advice: Link the greeting to the exact moment you unlock your computer (the cue) and then walk straight to the nearest inspection station (the stack). Phrase it as an if‑then plan: If I log in at 8:00 am, then I will say “Buenos días, ¿cómo va la línea hoy?” and follow with one specific question about yesterday’s line performance. Keep the script identical each day so the cue‑action link becomes automatic; on a rough day, the fallback is simply “Buenos día” (the floor version).

t.lesson: After you log in, send a brief email to your supplier asking: “Do you have recent test results confirming the product is free of mercury?” Keep it under 30 seconds to write and send.
